name: The Warlords
caption: Unsuccessful challengers for the SCW Florida Tag-Team Titles on the CWF branch show.

name: The Westside Bulldogs

tenures.source: Won the Television Tag Team Championship on 28 February 1999, then defended it into March.

caption: A tag team that won the Television Tag Team Championship in a title match turned by two masked interferers.

name: Corruption and Violence

tenures.source: Reached the Continental Cup semifinals, then challenged for the National Tag Team Championship and the vacant Southern States Tag Team Championship.

caption: A tag team that reached the Continental Cup semifinals before challenging for both the National and vacant Southern States Tag Team Championships.

name: Domination

tenures.source: Reached the Continental Cup semifinals, then challenged for the National Tag Team Championship at the promotion's own first pay-per-view.

caption: A tag team that reached the Continental Cup semifinals before falling short of the National Tag Team Championship at the promotion's own first pay-per-view.

identity.note: Name collision only: a same-named entity in another wing (domination-newf); no shared operator, chronology or storyline evidence in this wing's documents.

name: The Electric Mayhem

tenures.source: Part of the Mayhem Inc. stable; lost a rematch to Silfverling Dines and Myth Maker PWK on 28 February 1999.

caption: Part of the Mayhem Inc. stable, managed by Jessica, who lost a rematch to a returning Silfverling Dines and Myth Maker PWK.

name: The Frasier Brothers

tenures.source: Held the Southern States Tag Team Championship entering the Continental Cup, and the National Tag Team Championship by the promotion's own first pay-per-view.

caption: A tag team that held both the Southern States and National Tag Team Championships during 1999, retaining the latter by disqualification at the promotion's own first pay-per-view.

name: Thunderstorm

tenures.source: Won the vacant Southern States Tag Team Championship at the promotion's own first pay-per-view.

caption: A tag team that won the vacant Southern States Tag Team Championship at the promotion's own first pay-per-view by tricking an opponent into a blind tag.

identity.note: Shares a bare unit name with an already-held stable of a different, earlier promotion; no operator, roster or storyline axis ties the two.

name: Acid Rayne

tenures.source: A recurring tag team through 1999, later a challenger for the vacant Southern States Tag Team Championship.

caption: A recurring tag team through 1999 that fell short of the vacant Southern States Tag Team Championship at the promotion's own first pay-per-view.

name: The Playpen

tenures.source: Billed as reigning Television Tag Team Champions entering the promotion's own first pay-per-view, where they lost the title.

caption: A tag team, led by Rick Showboat's own faction, that lost the Television Tag Team Championship at the promotion's own first pay-per-view.
